title: Hat Ising critical line
plain: Ising models on a hat tiling and its dual should be exactly related at their critical points. Prove the duality relation holds rigorously.
math: For the ferromagnetic Ising model on the hat graph $G$ and its planar dual $G^*$, prove $\sinh(2\beta_c(G))\sinh(2\beta_c(G^*))=1$.
